Leaflet 1.9.4, vendored from https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/ (BSD-2-Clause, see LICENSE).

Served by the API under /web/vendor/leaflet/ so the map page loads no code
from a CDN. Map TILES are a separate matter: web/map.html fetches street
tiles from tile.openstreetmap.org when it can, and falls back to the built-in
schematic outline when it cannot (air-gapped site). See docs/CAPABILITIES.md.
